column1: # Genes and variants recurrently mutated in clonal hematopoiesis (CH), used by clonal_hematopoiesis.py
# to flag plasma variants that may come from white blood cells instead of the tumor. Research use only.
# tier 1: typically CH - flagged "CH suspected" on their own.
# tier 2: mutated in both CH and tumors - "CH compatible", "CH suspected" only with one more piece of evidence.
# classes: any (non-synonymous) / truncating / missense, comma-separated; empty = hotspots only.
# hotspots: protein positions or changes matched against HGVSp_Short (R882 matches p.R882H, p.R882C...).
# exons: restrict "classes" to these exons (MAF EXON / Exon_Number column); empty = any exon.
# Sources: Razavi et al. 2019 Nat Med doi:10.1038/s41591-019-0652-7; Hu et al. 2018 Clin Cancer Res
